fr_html: M. RICCI-BUSATTI fait remarquer que la question de la permanence de la Cour est liée à celles de l'incompatibilité de la fonction de juge avec d'autres fonctions, et de la rémunération des juges.
en_html: M. RICCI-BUSATTI pointed out that the question of the permanency of the Court was closely connected with those of the incompatibility of the duties as judge with other functions, and also with that of the remuneration to be given to the judges.
